content: As of Aug 31, 2026, new apps/updates on Google Play must target Android 16 (API level 36); existing apps must target at least API 35 to remain visible to new users on newer OS versions. Extensions to Nov 1, 2026 are available on request. This is a moving yearly target -- build tooling (Capacitor's Android platform + Android Gradle Plugin) must be kept current at submission time.
